name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoefficientDual.mem_annihilator_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_annihilator_iff (N : Submodule k M) (phi : M →ₗ[k] E) :
    phi ∈ annihilator (E := E) N ↔ ∀ n ∈ N, phi n = 0

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoefficientDual.range_lcomp_eq_annihilator_ker
statement:
theorem range_lcomp_eq_annihilator_ker
    {N : Type uN} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    [Small.{uE} k] [Module.Injective k E]
    (t : M →ₗ[k] N) :
    LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lcomp k E t) =
      annihilator (E := E) (LinearMap.ker t)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.finiteIndecomposableDecomposition_of_rank
statement:
theorem finiteIndecomposableDecomposition_of_rank

    [HasBinaryBiproducts C] [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    (rank : C → ℕ)
    (zero_of_rank_eq_zero : ∀ X, rank X = 0 → IsZero X)
    (rank_biprod : ∀ {X Y Z : C},
      (X ≅ (Y ⊞ Z : C)) → rank X = rank Y + rank Z) :
    ∀ X : C, Nonempty (FiniteIndecomposableDecomposition X)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.functor_essSurj_of_indec_dense

    [HasFiniteBiproducts C] [HasFiniteBiproducts D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    (decomposition : ∀ Y : D, Nonempty (FiniteIndecomposableDecomposition Y))
    (dense : ∀ Y : D, Indecomposable Y →
      ∃ X : C, Nonempty (F.obj X ≅ Y)) :
    F.EssSurj

statement:
theorem finrank_hom_le_one_of_ext_vanishing
    (F : ι → C) (hF : ∀ i, ¬ IsZero (F i))
    (hdec : ∀ X : C, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ label : Fin n → ι,
      Nonempty (X ≅ ⨁ fun j ↦ F (label j)))
    (Z I : C) [Injective I]
    (hZ : ∀ a : Z ⟶ Z, ∃ c : k, a = c • 𝟙 Z)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.binaryBiproductShortComplex_exact_of_map
statement:
theorem binaryBiproductShortComplex_exact_of_map
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Faithful]
    {X A B Y : C} [PreservesBinaryBiproduct A B F]
    (fA : X ⟶ A) (fB : X ⟶ B)
    (gA : A ⟶ Y) (gB : B ⟶ Y)
    (hzero : fA ≫ gA + fB ≫ gB = 0)
    (hmap :
      (binaryBiproductShortComplex
        (F.map fA) (F.map fB) (F.map gA) (F.map gB) (by
          rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, ← F.map_add, hzero, F.map_zero])).Exact) :
    (binaryBiproductShortComplex fA fB gA gB hzero).Exact

name: MagnitudeConjecture.assoc_comp_congr

statement:
theorem precomp_congr
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {X Y Z : C}

    f ≫ g = f ≫ h

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_end_middle_biprod_lt
statement:
theorem ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_end_middle_biprod_lt
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hnonsplit : ¬ IsSplitMono S.f) (R : C) :
    Module.finrank k ((S.X₂ ⊞ R) ⟶ (S.X₂ ⊞ R)) <
      Module.finrank k
        (((S.X₁ ⊞ S.X₃) ⊞ R) ⟶ ((S.X₁ ⊞ S.X₃) ⊞ R))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_end_middle_lt_endpoint_blocks
statement:
theorem ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_end_middle_lt_endpoint_blocks
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hnonsplit : ¬ IsSplitMono S.f) :
    Module.finrank k (S.X₂ ⟶ S.X₂) <
      Module.finrank k (S.X₁ ⟶ S.X₁) +
      Module.finrank k (S.X₁ ⟶ S.X₃) +
      Module.finrank k (S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₁) +
      Module.finrank k (S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₃)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_hom_from_middle_le
statement:
theorem ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_hom_from_middle_le
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) (W : C) :
    Module.finrank k (S.X₂ ⟶ W) ≤
      Module.finrank k (S.X₃ ⟶ W) +
        Module.finrank k (S.X₁ ⟶ W)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_hom_middle_to_source_lt
statement:
theorem ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_hom_middle_to_source_lt
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)

    Module.finrank k (S.X₂ ⟶ S.X₁) <
      Module.finrank k (S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₁) +
        Module.finrank k (S.X₁ ⟶ S.X₁)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_hom_to_middle_le
statement:
theorem ShortComplex.ShortExact.finrank_hom_to_middle_le
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) (W : C) :
    Module.finrank k (W ⟶ S.X₂) ≤
      Module.finrank k (W ⟶ S.X₁) +
        Module.finrank k (W ⟶ S.X₃)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.leftComp_exact
statement:

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.rightComp_exact

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.finrank_end_biprod
statement:
theorem finrank_end_biprod (X Y : C) :
    Module.finrank k ((X ⊞ Y) ⟶ (X ⊞ Y)) =
      Module.finrank k (X ⟶ X) +
      Module.finrank k (X ⟶ Y) +
      Module.finrank k (Y ⟶ X) +
      Module.finrank k (Y ⟶ Y)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearMap.finrank_eq_add_of_exact_of_injective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_add_of_exact_of_injective_of_surjective
    (f : U →ₗ[k] V) (g : V →ₗ[k] W)
    (hfg : Function.Exact f g)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearMap.finrank_le_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem finrank_le_add_of_exact
    (f : U →ₗ[k] V) (g : V →ₗ[k] W)

    Module.finrank k V ≤ Module.finrank k U + Module.finrank k W

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearMap.finrank_lt_add_of_exact_of_not_surjective
statement:
theorem finrank_lt_add_of_exact_of_not_surjective
    (f : U →ₗ[k] V) (g : V →ₗ[k] W)
    (hfg : Function.Exact f g)
    (hg : ¬ Function.Surjective g) :
    Module.finrank k V < Module.finrank k U + Module.finrank k W

name: CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.kernelMap_comp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.finrank_map_eq_mul
statement:
theorem finrank_map_eq_mul (F : FGModuleCat.{u} k ⥤ FGModuleCat.{u} k)
    [F.Additive] (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k) :
    Module.finrank k (F.obj V) =
      Module.finrank k V * Module.finrank k (F.obj (FGModuleCat.of k k))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.coordinateMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateMap_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k) (b : Module.Basis ι k V) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    (coordinateMap V b i).hom.hom v = b.repr v i

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.functorEvaluationSection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functorEvaluationSection_apply
    (F : FGModuleCat.{u} k ⥤ FGModuleCat.{u} k)
    [F.Additive] [F.Linear k] (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k) (y : F.obj V) :
    (functorEvaluationSection F V).hom.hom y =
      ∑ i, (F.map (coordinateMap V (Module.finBasis k V) i)).hom.hom y
        ⊗ₜ[k] (Module.finBasis k V) i

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.functorEvaluationSection_comp_evaluation
statement:
theorem functorEvaluationSection_comp_evaluation
    (F : FGModuleCat.{u} k ⥤ FGModuleCat.{u} k)
    [F.Additive] [F.Linear k] (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k) :
    functorEvaluationSection F V ≫ functorEvaluation F V = 𝟙 (F.obj V)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.functorEvaluation_bijective
statement:
theorem functorEvaluation_bijective
    (F : FGModuleCat.{u} k ⥤ FGModuleCat.{u} k)

    Function.Bijective (functorEvaluation F V).hom.hom

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.functorEvaluation_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functorEvaluation_tmul
    (F : FGModuleCat.{u} k ⥤ FGModuleCat.{u} k)
    [F.Additive] [F.Linear k]
    (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k)
    (x : F.obj (FGModuleCat.of k k)) (v : V) :
    (functorEvaluation F V).hom.hom (x ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      (F.map (pointMap V v)).hom.hom x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.hom_hom_sum
statement:

theorem hom_hom_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {V W : FGModuleCat.{u} k} (f : ι → (V ⟶ W)) :
    (∑ i, f i).hom.hom = ∑ i, (f i).hom.hom

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.pointMap_add
statement:

theorem pointMap_add (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k) (v w : V) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.pointMap_apply
statement:

theorem pointMap_apply (V : FGModuleCat.{u} k) (v : V) (a : k) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.FiniteVectorSpace.pointMap_smul

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedCategory.HomGrading.part_zero_comp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.FiniteIndecomposableDecomposition.exists_factorization_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_factorization_decomposition (P : C → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ Z : C, Indecomposable Z → ∀ f : Z ⟶ Y, f ≠ 0 → P Z)
    (hd : Nonempty (FiniteIndecomposableDecomposition M))
    (a : X ⟶ M) (b : M ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ d : FiniteIndecomposableDecomposition M,
      (∀ q : d.IncomingIndex b, P (d.summand q.val)) ∧
      (letI : Fintype (d.IncomingIndex b) := Fintype.ofFinite _;
        a ≫ b = ∑ q : d.IncomingIndex b,
          d.outgoingComponent a q.val ≫ d.incomingComponent b q.val)

    {X Y Z : C} (a : Y ⟶ X) (b : Z ⟶ Y) :
    linearExtPrecompAlong (R := R) T n (b ≫ a) =
      linearExtPrecompAlong (R := R) T n a ≫
        linearExtPrecompAlong (R := R) T n b

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.linearExtPrecompAlong_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearExtPrecompAlong_id (T : D ⥤ C) (X : C) (n : ℕ) :
    linearExtPrecompAlong (R := R) T n (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 _

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.QuiverRep.map_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem QuiverRep.map_nil (M : QuiverRep k Q) (a : Q) :

      𝟙 (M.obj (show Paths Q from a))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.homPathBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homPathBasis_apply (x y : Category k Q)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.homPathLinearEquiv_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homPathLinearEquiv_id (x : Category k Q) :
    homPathLinearEquiv x x (𝟙 x) = Finsupp.single Quiver.Path.nil 1

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.homPathLinearEquiv_pathHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homPathLinearEquiv_pathHom {x y : Category k Q}
    (p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x)) :
    homPathLinearEquiv x y (pathHom p) = Finsupp.single p 1

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_comp
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem pathHom_comp {x y z : Category k Q}
    (p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x))
    (q : Quiver.Path (vertex z) (vertex y)) :
    pathHom p ≫ pathHom q = pathHom (q.comp p)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_hom
statement:
theorem pathHom_hom {x y : Category k Q}
    (p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x)) :
    (pathHom p).hom =
      representableHom (vertex x) (representable k Q (vertex y))
        (representableBasis (vertex y) (vertex x) p)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathHom_nil (x : Category k Q) :
    pathHom (Quiver.Path.nil : Quiver.Path (vertex x) (vertex x)) = 𝟙 x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.representableHomEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representableHomEquiv_apply (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q)
    (f : representable k Q i ⟶ M) :
    representableHomEquiv i M f =
      f.app i (representableBasis i i Quiver.Path.nil)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.representableHomEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representableHomEquiv_symm_apply (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q)
    (x : M.obj (show Paths Q from i)) :
    (representableHomEquiv i M).symm x = representableHom i M x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.representableHom_app_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representableHom_app_basis (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q)
    (x : M.obj (show Paths Q from i)) (j : Q) (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
    (representableHom i M x).app j (representableBasis i j p) = M.map p x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.representableHom_app_nil
statement:
theorem representableHom_app_nil (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q)
    (x : M.obj (show Paths Q from i)) :
    (representableHom i M x).app i
      (representableBasis i i Quiver.Path.nil) = x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.representableHom_app_nil_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representableHom_app_nil_self {i : Q} {M : QuiverRep k Q}
    (f : representable k Q i ⟶ M) :
    representableHom i M
      (f.app i (representableBasis i i Quiver.Path.nil)) = f

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.representable_map_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representable_map_basis (i : Q) {a b : Q}
    (p : Quiver.Path a b) (q : Quiver.Path i a) :
    (representable k Q i).map p (representableBasis i a q) =
      representableBasis i b (q.comp p)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.homMap_pathHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homMap_pathHom (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    {x y : Category k Q}
    (p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x)) :
    homMap F₀ F₁ x y (pathHom p) = pathMap F₀ F₁ p

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.homPathLinearEquiv_symm_single
MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lift_map_pathHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_map_pathHom (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    {x y : Category k Q}
    (p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x)) :
    (lift (k := k) F₀ F₁).map (pathHom p) = pathMap F₀ F₁ p

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lift_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_obj (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    (x : Category k Q) :
    (lift (k := k) F₀ F₁).obj x = F₀ (vertex x)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_comp
statement:
theorem pathMap_comp (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    {i j l : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j) (q : Quiver.Path j l) :
    pathMap F₀ F₁ (p.comp q) = pathMap F₀ F₁ q ≫ pathMap F₀ F₁ p

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathMap_cons (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    {i j l : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j) (a : j ⟶ l) :
    pathMap F₀ F₁ (p.cons a) = F₁ a ≫ pathMap F₀ F₁ p

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_naturality
statement:
theorem pathMap_naturality
    (F₀ G₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    (G₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (G₀ j ⟶ G₀ i))
    (α : ∀ i, F₀ i ⟶ G₀ i)
    (hα : ∀ {i j : Q} (a : i ⟶ j),
      F₁ a ≫ α i = α j ≫ G₁ a)
    {i j : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
    pathMap F₀ F₁ p ≫ α i = α j ≫ pathMap G₀ G₁ p

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathMap_nil (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i)) (i : Q) :
    pathMap F₀ F₁ (Quiver.Path.nil : Quiver.Path i i) = 𝟙 (F₀ i)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.dfinsuppBasis_apply
statement:
theorem dfinsuppBasis_apply
    {ι : Type*} {M : ι → Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)] [∀ i, Module k (M i)]
    {η : ι → Type*} (b : ∀ i, Module.Basis (η i) k (M i))
    (i : ι) (j : η i) :
    DFinsupp.basis b ⟨i, j⟩ = DirectSum.lof k ι M i (b i j)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.eqToHom_comp_pathHom_eq_cast_end
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_pathHom_eq_cast_end
    {i j j' : Q₂} (p : Quiver.Path i j) (h : j = j') :
    eqToHom (congrArg (obj k Q₂) h).symm ≫ pathHom p =
      pathHom (p.cast rfl h)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_comp_eqToHom_eq_cast_start
statement:
theorem pathHom_comp_eqToHom_eq_cast_start
    {i i' j : Q₂} (p : Quiver.Path i j) (h : i = i') :
    pathHom p ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (obj k Q₂) h) =
      pathHom (p.cast h rfl)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_eq_eqToHom_comp_cast_end
statement:
theorem pathHom_eq_eqToHom_comp_cast_end
    {i j j' : Q₂} (p : Quiver.Path i j) (h : j = j') :
    pathHom p = eqToHom (congrArg (obj k Q₂) h) ≫
      pathHom (p.cast rfl h)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_prefunctorArrowHom
statement:
theorem pathMap_prefunctorArrowHom (π : Q₁ ⥤q Q₂)

    pathMap (fun x ↦ obj k Q₂ (π.obj x))

theorem prefunctorFunctor_map_pathHom (π : Q₁ ⥤q Q₂)

theorem sourceFiberHomBasisEquiv_eq_map

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.sourceFiberHomBasis_apply
statement:
theorem sourceFiberHomBasis_apply (π : Q₁ ⥤q Q₂)
    (x : Q₂) (y : Q₁)
    (Z : MagnitudeConjecture.LinearCovering.Fiber
      (prefunctorFunctor (k := k) π) (obj k Q₂ x))
    (p : Quiver.Path y (vertex Z.1)) :
    sourceFiberHomBasis (k := k) π x y ⟨Z, p⟩ =
      MagnitudeConjecture.LinearCovering.sourceFiberLof

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.sourcePathEquiv_apply
statement:

theorem sourcePathEquiv_apply (π : Q₁ ⥤q Q₂) (hπ : π.IsCovering)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.targetFiberHomBasis_apply
statement:
theorem targetFiberHomBasis_apply (π : Q₁ ⥤q Q₂)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.targetPathEquiv_apply

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.incomingSum_single
statement:

theorem incomingSum_single {x z : Q} (a₀ : IncomingArrow z)

statement:

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.homMap_eq_of_eq_on_source_le
statement:
theorem homMap_eq_of_eq_on_source_le
    (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ G₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    (harrow : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → j < i)
    {x z : Q} (f : obj k Q x ⟶ obj k Q z)
    (h : ∀ {a b : Q} (e : a ⟶ b), a ≤ z → F₁ e = G₁ e) :
    homMap F₀ F₁ (obj k Q x) (obj k Q z) f =
      homMap F₀ G₁ (obj k Q x) (obj k Q z) f

theorem outgoingSum_single {x z : Q} (a₀ : OutgoingArrow x)
    (f : obj k Q a₀.1 ⟶ obj k Q z) :
    outgoingSum (singleOutgoingCoefficient (k := k) a₀ f) =
      outgoingArrowHom (k := k) a₀ ≫ f

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_eq_of_eq_on_source_le
statement:
theorem pathMap_eq_of_eq_on_source_le
    (F₀ : Q → C)
    (F₁ G₁ : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i))
    (harrow : ∀ {i j : Q}, (i ⟶ j) → j < i)
    {i j : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j)
    (h : ∀ {a b : Q} (e : a ⟶ b), a ≤ i → F₁ e = G₁ e) :
    pathMap F₀ F₁ p = pathMap F₀ G₁ p

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_toPath
statement:

theorem pathMap_toPath {i j : Q} (a : i ⟶ j) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CategoricalGrading.comp_comp_mem
statement:
theorem comp_comp_mem
    (A : ∀ X Y : C, ℕ → Submodule k (X ⟶ Y))
    (hcomp : ∀ {W X Y : C} {i j : ℕ} {a : W ⟶ X} {b : X ⟶ Y},
      a ∈ A W X i → b ∈ A X Y j → a ≫ b ∈ A W Y (i + j))
    {W X Y Z : C} {i j l : ℕ}
    {a : W ⟶ X} {b : X ⟶ Y} {c : Y ⟶ Z}
    (ha : a ∈ A W X i) (hb : b ∈ A X Y j) (hc : c ∈ A Y Z l) :

MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.comp_mem_lengthTail

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lengthComponent_eq_map
statement:
theorem lengthComponent_eq_map (x y : Category k Q) (n : ℕ) :
    lengthComponent x y n =

        (fun p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x) ↦ p.length) n).map

statement:
theorem lengthComponent_eq_span (x y : Category k Q) (n : ℕ) :
    lengthComponent x y n = Submodule.span k (lengthBasisSet x y n)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lengthComponent_isInternal

theorem lengthComponent_isInternal (x y : Category k Q) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lengthComponent_zero_eq_bot_of_vertex_ne
MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lengthComponent_zero_self

theorem lengthComponent_zero_self (x : Category k Q) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lengthTail_antitone
statement:
theorem lengthTail_antitone (x y : Category k Q) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.lengthTail_eq_span
statement:
theorem lengthTail_eq_span (x y : Category k Q) (n : ℕ) :
    lengthTail x y n =
      Submodule.span k
        (pathHom ''
          {p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x) | n ≤ p.length})

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.mem_lengthComponent_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lengthComponent_iff (x y : Category k Q) (n : ℕ) (f : x ⟶ y) :
    f ∈ lengthComponent x y n ↔
      ((homPathLinearEquiv x y f).support :
        Set (Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x))) ⊆
          {p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x) | p.length = n}

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.mem_lengthTail_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lengthTail_iff (x y : Category k Q) (n : ℕ) (f : x ⟶ y) :
    f ∈ lengthTail x y n ↔
      ((homPathLinearEquiv x y f).support :
        Set (Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x))) ⊆
          {p : Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x) | n ≤ p.length}

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.mem_positivePathSubmodule_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_positivePathSubmodule_iff (x y : Category k Q) (f : x ⟶ y) :
    f ∈ positivePathSubmodule x y ↔
      ((homPathLinearEquiv x y f).support :
        Set (Quiver.Path (vertex y) (vertex x))) ⊆

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.mem_positivePathSubmodule_self_iff
statement:
theorem mem_positivePathSubmodule_self_iff (x : Category k Q) (f : x ⟶ x) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.nilPathCoefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_lengthComponent

theorem nilPathCoefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_lengthComponent

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_mem_lengthComponent_iff

theorem pathHom_mem_lengthComponent_iff {x y : Category k Q}

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.pathHom_mem_lengthTail_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathHom_mem_lengthTail_iff {x y : Category k Q}

statement:

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearPathCategory.exists_eq_toPath_of_length_one
statement:

    (factorExcess_nonnegative : 0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi)
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows) :

      intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 0 ∧ newArrows = newMeshes

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_deletionCost
statement:
theorem translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_deletionCost
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z p newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount : intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - p - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (p - 1)) :
    translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
        translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB =
      deletionCost Phi newArrows newMeshes

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative
statement:
theorem translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z p newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount : intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - p - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (p - 1))
    (factorExcess_nonnegative : 0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi)
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows) :
    0 ≤ translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
      translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB

    [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (f : X → M)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = f x) :
    (∑ x, f x) = Fintype.card G •
      ∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X,
        orbitInvariantDescend f invariant q

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.sum_orbitInvariantDescend_eq_sum_of_orbitClassifier
statement:
theorem sum_orbitInvariantDescend_eq_sum_of_orbitClassifier
    {Y M : Type*} [Fintype X]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X)] [Fintype Y]
    [AddCommMonoid M]
    (c : X → Y)
    (c_invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), c (g • x) = c x)
    (c_surjective : Function.Surjective c)
    (c_fiber : ∀ x y, c x = c y → ∃ g : G, g • y = x)
    (f : X → M)
    (f_invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = f x)
    (t : Y → M)
    (value_eq : ∀ x, f x = t (c x)) :
    (∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X,
        orbitInvariantDescend f f_invariant q) =
      ∑ y : Y, t y

theorem interactionNeighborhood_mono

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.interactionNeighborhood_smul
statement:
theorem interactionNeighborhood_smul
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (g : G) (W : Set X) :
    interactionNeighborhood R (g • W) =

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite
statement:
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (locallyFinite : ∀ x : X, {y : X | R x y}.Finite)
    (W : Set X) (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W).Finite
  | 0 => hW
  | n + 1 => interactionNeighborhood_finite R locallyFinite _
      (iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite R locallyFinite W hW n)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul
statement:
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (g : G) (W : Set X) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n (g • W) =
        g • iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      change
        interactionNeighborhood R
            (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n (g • W)) =
          g • interactionNeighborhood R
            (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W)
      rw [iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul R invariant g W n,
        interactionNeighborhood_smul R invariant]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_subset_succ

theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_succ

    (hnonneg : ∀ m, 0 ≤ interval m)
    (hupper : ∀ m, m₀ ≤ m → interval m ≤ ((m : ℤ) + 1) * σ + C) :

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.interval_eq_zero_of_packing
statement:

statement:
theorem slope_nonpositive_of_eventually_bounded
    (s C : ℤ) (n₀ : ℕ)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.surplus_error_bound
statement:
theorem surplus_error_bound
    (N a p Nₘ aₘ pₘ c Cₙ Cₐ : ℤ)
    (hN : |Nₘ - c * N| ≤ Cₙ) (ha : |aₘ - c * a| ≤ Cₐ)
    (hp : pₘ = c * p) :
    |(2 * Nₘ - aₘ - 2 * pₘ) - c * (2 * N - a - 2 * p)| ≤
      2 * Cₙ + Cₐ

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.allowedShifts_subset
statement:
theorem allowedShifts_subset (m l u h : ℕ) (hlh : l ≤ h) :
    allowedShifts m l u ⊆ Finset.Icc (-(h : ℤ)) (m : ℤ)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.boundary_strip_card_le
statement:
theorem boundary_strip_card_le (m h : ℕ) :
    (Finset.Ico (-(h : ℤ)) 0 ∪
      Finset.Ioc ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) (m : ℤ)).card ≤ 3 * h

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.card_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem card_allowedShifts (m l u : ℕ) (hum : u ≤ m) :
    ((allowedShifts m l u).card : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 1 - ((u : ℤ) - l)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.exceptional_allowedShifts_card_le
statement:
theorem exceptional_allowedShifts_card_le (m l u h : ℕ) (hlh : l ≤ h) :
    ((allowedShifts m l u).filter
      (fun t ↦ ¬ (0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h))).card ≤ 3 * h

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.exceptional_shift_mem
statement:
theorem exceptional_shift_mem (m h : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : t ∈ Finset.Icc (-(h : ℤ)) (m : ℤ))
    (hout : ¬ (0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h)) :
    t ∈ Finset.Ico (-(h : ℤ)) 0 ∪
      Finset.Ioc ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) (m : ℤ)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.incoming_shift_allowed
statement:
theorem incoming_shift_allowed (m h l u : ℕ) (huh : u ≤ h)
    (s t : ℤ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htm : t ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h)
    (hst : t ≤ s) (hsth : s ≤ t + h) :
    s ∈ allowedShifts m l u

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.mem_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem mem_allowedShifts (m l u : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    t ∈ allowedShifts m l u ↔ 0 ≤ (l : ℤ) + t ∧ (u : ℤ) + t ≤ m

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.sum_card_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem sum_card_allowedShifts {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (l u : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (hum : ∀ x ∈ s, u x ≤ m) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, ((allowedShifts m (l x) (u x)).card : ℤ) =
      (s.card : ℤ) * ((m : ℤ) + 1) - ∑ x ∈ s, ((u x : ℤ) - l x)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.SupportWindow.lower_le_upper
statement: theorem SupportWindow.lower_le_upper {D : Finset ℤ} (W : SupportWindow D) : W.lower ≤ W.upper

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.SupportWindow.shift_supported_iff
statement:
theorem SupportWindow.shift_supported_iff {D : Finset ℤ} (W : SupportWindow D) (m : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    (∀ d ∈ D, 0 ≤ d + t ∧ d + t ≤ m) ↔ t ∈ allowedShifts m W.lower W.upper

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.sigmaFinset_filter_card_le
statement:
theorem sigmaFinset_filter_card_le (F : ι → Finset ℤ) (P : ι → ℤ → Prop)
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (P i)] (B : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i, ((F i).filter (P i)).card ≤ B) :
    Nat.card {a : Σ i, ↥(F i) // P a.1 a.2.val} ≤ Fintype.card ι * B

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.total_exceptional_allowedShifts_card_le
statement:
theorem total_exceptional_allowedShifts_card_le (m h : ℕ) (l r : ι → ℕ)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≤ h) :
    Nat.card {a : Σ i, ↥(allowedShifts m (l i) (r i)) //
      ¬ (0 ≤ a.2.val ∧ a.2.val ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h)} ≤ Fintype.card ι * (3 * h)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.interior_subset_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem interior_subset_allowedShifts (m h l r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ h) :
    Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) ⊆ allowedShifts m l r

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.interior_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem interior_weighted_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (m h : ℕ) (l r : ι → ℕ) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≤ h) (hm : 2 * h ≤ m)
    (w : ι → ℕ) :
    (∑ a : {a : (i : ι) × ↥(allowedShifts m (l i) (r i)) //
        0 ≤ a.2.val ∧ a.2.val ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h}, w a.val.1) =
      (m - 2 * h + 1) * ∑ i, w i

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.count_of_balance
statement:
theorem count_of_balance (A N p L Hp Hm outside : ℤ)
    (hheight : Hm - Hp = 2 * (N - p))
    (hout : outside = A - p + 1)
    (hbalance : A = 2 * outside + Hp - Hm + L) :
    A = 2 * N - L - 2 ∧ 2 * N - A - p - 1 = L - (p - 1)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.weighted_difference
statement:
theorem weighted_difference (a : V → V → ℤ) (h : V → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ x y, a x y ≠ 0 → h y = h x + 1) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, a x y) =
      (∑ y, h y * ∑ x, a x y) - (∑ x, h x * ∑ y, a x y)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.boundary_height_difference
statement:
theorem boundary_height_difference
    (P I : V → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred I]
    (e : {x // ¬ P x} ≃ {x // ¬ I x}) (h : V → ℤ)
    (he : ∀ x, h x.1 = h (e x).1 + 2) :
    (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1) - (∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1) =
      2 * ((Fintype.card V : ℤ) - Fintype.card {x // P x})

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.count_of_boundary_sums
statement:
theorem count_of_boundary_sums
    (P I : V → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred I]
    (e : {x // ¬ P x} ≃ {x // ¬ I x})
    (h incoming outgoing : V → ℤ) (A L : ℤ)
    (he : ∀ x, h x.1 = h (e x).1 + 2)
    (ha : ∀ x, incoming x.1 = outgoing (e x).1)
    (hflux : A = (∑ x, h x * incoming x) - ∑ x, h x * outgoing x)
    (htotal : ∑ x, outgoing x = A)
    (hpin : (∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1 * incoming x.1) =
      ∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1)
    (hiout : (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1 * outgoing x.1) =
      (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1) - L)
    (hicount : (∑ x : {x // I x}, outgoing x.1) =
      (Fintype.card {x // P x} : ℤ) - 1) :
    A = 2 * Fintype.card V - L - 2 ∧
      2 * Fintype.card V - A - Fintype.card {x // P x} - 1 =
        L - ((Fintype.card {x // P x} : ℤ) - 1)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.weighted_translation_sum
statement:
theorem weighted_translation_sum
    (P I : V → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred I]
    (e : {x // ¬ P x} ≃ {x // ¬ I x})
    (h incoming outgoing : V → ℤ)
    (he : ∀ x, h x.1 = h (e x).1 + 2)
    (ha : ∀ x, incoming x.1 = outgoing (e x).1) :
    (∑ x : {x // ¬ P x}, h x.1 * incoming x.1) =
      (∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, h x.1 * outgoing x.1) +
        2 * ∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, outgoing x.1

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.boundary_card_eq
MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.boundary_sums
statement:
theorem boundary_sums [DecidableEq V] (s : V) (h d : V → ℤ)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = if x = s then 0 else 1) :
    (∑ x, d x) = Fintype.card V - 1 ∧
    (∑ x, h x * d x) = (∑ x, h x) - h s

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.arrow_error_bound_from_partition
statement:
theorem arrow_error_bound_from_partition {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (f : α → α → ℕ) (g : β → β → ℕ)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (m h B : ℕ) (hm : 2 * h ≤ m)
    (hi : (∑ b : {b : α // P b}, ∑ a : α, f a b.val) =
      (m - 2 * h + 1) * ∑ b : β, ∑ a : β, g a b)
    (hb : (∑ b : {b : α // ¬ P b}, ∑ a : α, f a b.val) ≤ B) :
    |ARCount.arrowCount f - ((m : ℤ) + 1) * ARCount.arrowCount g| ≤
      (B : ℤ) + 2 * h * ARCount.arrowCount g

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.card_groupOrbitQuotientMap_fiber_eq
statement:
theorem card_groupOrbitQuotientMap_fiber_eq
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (f : X → Y)
    (equivariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = g • f x)
    (y : Y) :
    Nat.card
        {q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X //
          groupOrbitQuotientMap f equivariant q =
            (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y)} =
      Nat.card {x : X // f x = y}

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk (f : X → Y)
    (equivariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = g • f x)
    (x : X) :
    groupOrbitQuotientMap f equivariant
        (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X) =
      (Quotient.mk'' (f x) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.groupOrbitQuotientProperty_mk_iff
statement:
theorem groupOrbitQuotientProperty_mk_iff
    (P : Y → Prop)

    (y : Y) :
    GroupOrbitQuotientProperty P
        (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) ↔
      P y

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.indegree_arrowMultiplicityOfOccurrences_eq
statement:
theorem indegree_arrowMultiplicityOfOccurrences_eq
    {Arrow Vertex : Type*} [Finite Arrow] [Fintype Vertex]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.localDensity_arrowMultiplicityOfOccurrences_eq
statement:
theorem localDensity_arrowMultiplicityOfOccurrences_eq
    {Arrow Vertex : Type*} [Finite Arrow] [Fintype Vertex]
    (source target : Arrow → Vertex)
    (IsProjective : Vertex → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (y : Vertex) :

        (arrowMultiplicityOfOccurrences source target) IsProjective y =

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.occurrenceIndegree_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk
statement:
theorem occurrenceIndegree_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]

      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)

statement:

    (target : X → Y)

    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (y : Y) :
    occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective)
        (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) =
      occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y

    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (target : X → Y)

      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)

statement:

    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) :
    orbitInvariantDescend
        (occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective)
        (occurrenceLocalDensity_invariant target target_equivariant
          IsProjective projective_invariant) q =
      occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective) q

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.sum_occurrenceLocalDensity_eq_group_card_mul_quotient
statement:
theorem sum_occurrenceLocalDensity_eq_group_card_mul_quotient
    [Fintype G] [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y)]
    [IsCancelSMul G Y]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y) :
    (∑ y, occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y) =
      (Fintype.card G : ℤ) *
        ∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y,
          occurrenceLocalDensity
            (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
            (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective) q

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectSumFubini.mapRangeLinearEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRangeLinearEquiv_of
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {iota : Type uI}
    {beta : iota → Type uM} {gamma : iota → Type uT}
    [DecidableEq iota]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (beta i)] [∀ i, Module R (beta i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (gamma i)] [∀ i, Module R (gamma i)]
    (e : ∀ i, beta i ≃ₗ[R] gamma i) (i : iota) (x : beta i) :
    mapRangeLinearEquiv e (DirectSum.of beta i x) =
      DirectSum.of gamma i (e i x)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectSumFubini.reindexCastLinearEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexCastLinearEquiv_of
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {iota : Type uI} {kappa : Type uM}
    [DecidableEq iota] [DecidableEq kappa] (e : iota ≃ kappa)
    {T : kappa → Type uT}
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (T i)] [∀ i, Module R (T i)]
    (i : iota) (x : T (e i)) :
    (mapRangeLinearEquiv fun j ↦
        LinearEquiv.cast (R := R) (e.apply_symm_apply j))
        ((DirectSum.lequivCongrLeft R e)
          (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ T (e i)) i x)) =
      DirectSum.of T (e i) x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectSumFubini.sigmaLcurryEquiv_symm_of_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigmaLcurryEquiv_symm_of_of
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {iota : Type uI}
    {alpha : iota → Type uM} {T : (i : iota) → alpha i → Type uT}
    [DecidableEq iota] [∀ i, DecidableEq (alpha i)]
    [∀ i j, AddCommMonoid (T i j)] [∀ i j, Module R (T i j)]
    (i : iota) (j : alpha i) (x : T i j) :
    (DirectSum.sigmaLcurryEquiv R).symm
        (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ DirectSum (alpha i) (T i)) i
          (DirectSum.of (T i) j x)) =
      DirectSum.of (fun p : Σ i, alpha i ↦ T p.1 p.2)
        (⟨i, j⟩ : Σ i, alpha i) x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearAlgebra.PairSubquotient.quotientEquivIdentified_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientEquivIdentified_apply_mk
    (U D : Submodule k V) (U' D' : Submodule k W)
    (hSourceNum : U = sourceNumerator f Aplus Bplus)
    (hSourceDen : D = sourceDenominator f Aminus Aplus Bminus Bplus)
    (hTargetNum : targetNumerator f Aplus Bplus = U')
    (hTargetDen : targetDenominator f Aminus Aplus Bminus Bplus = D')
    (hA : Aminus ≤ Aplus) (hB : Bminus ≤ Bplus) (x : U) :
    quotientEquivIdentified f Aminus Aplus Bminus Bplus U D U' D'
        hSourceNum hSourceDen hTargetNum hTargetDen hA hB
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨f x.1, by
          rw [← hTargetNum]
          exact (numeratorMap f Aplus Bplus
            (⟨x.1, by rw [← hSourceNum]; exact x.2⟩ :
              sourceNumerator f Aplus Bplus)).2⟩ : U')

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearAlgebra.PairSubquotient.quotientEquivOfEq_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientEquivOfEq_apply_mk
    (U U' D D' : Submodule k V) (hU : U = U') (hD : D = D')
    (x : U) :
    quotientEquivOfEq U U' D D' hU hD (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨x, by rw [← hU]; exact x.2⟩ : U')

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearAlgebra.PairSubquotient.quotientEquivSwappedIdentified_apply_mk

theorem quotientEquivSwappedIdentified_apply_mk

    (hSourceNum : U = swappedSourceNumerator f Aplus Bplus)
    (hSourceDen : D = swappedSourceDenominator f Aminus Aplus Bminus Bplus)
    (hTargetNum : swappedTargetNumerator f Aplus Bplus = U')
    (hTargetDen : swappedTargetDenominator f Aminus Aplus Bminus Bplus = D')
    (hA : Aminus ≤ Aplus) (hB : Bminus ≤ Bplus) (x : U) :
    quotientEquivSwappedIdentified f Aminus Aplus Bminus Bplus U D U' D'
        hSourceNum hSourceDen hTargetNum hTargetDen hA hB
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨f x.1, by
          rw [← hTargetNum]
          exact (swappedNumeratorMap f Aplus Bplus
            (⟨x.1, by rw [← hSourceNum]; exact x.2⟩ :
              swappedSourceNumerator f Aplus Bplus)).2⟩ : U')

name: MagnitudeConjecture.LinearAlgebra.PairSubquotient.quotientEquivSwapped_apply_mk

name: MagnitudeConjecture.explicitBasisOfFamily_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem explicitBasisOfFamily_apply
    {ι R M : Type u} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (v : ι → M)
    (h : ∀ i, b i = v i) (i : ι) :
    explicitBasisOfFamily b v h i = v i

name: MagnitudeConjecture.piBasisVector_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piBasisVector_mk
    {R η : Type u} {ι : η → Type u} {M : η → Type u}
    [Semiring R] [Fintype η]
    [∀ a, AddCommMonoid (M a)] [∀ a, Module R (M a)]
    (s : ∀ a, Module.Basis (ι a) R (M a)) (a : η) (i : ι a) :
    piBasisVector s ⟨a, i⟩ = piSingle a (s a i)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.piExplicitBasis_apply
statement:

theorem piExplicitBasis_apply

    [∀ a, AddCommMonoid (M a)] [∀ a, Module R (M a)]
    (s : ∀ a, Module.Basis (ι a) R (M a)) (t : Σ a, ι a) :
    piExplicitBasis s t = piBasisVector s t

name: MagnitudeConjecture.piSingle_congr

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ScalarCorner.mem_span_and_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem mem_span_and_fixed_iff (p : R) (W : Submodule k M)
    (hfix : ∀ x ∈ W, p • x = x)
    (hcorner : ∀ a : R, ∃ c : k, p * a * p = algebraMap k R c * p)
    (x : M) :
    (x ∈ Submodule.span R (W : Set M) ∧ p • x = x) ↔ x ∈ W

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ScalarCorner.smul_mem_of_mem_span

    (hcorner : ∀ a : R, ∃ c : k, p * a * p = algebraMap k R c * p)
    {x : M} (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R (W : Set M)) : p • x ∈ W

name: Submodule.sum_coe_single

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CartanCoordinate.WeaklyPositiveCartanData.columnTail_dot_inverse_unit
statement:
theorem columnTail_dot_inverse_unit
    (D : WeaklyPositiveCartanData (ι := ι))
    (hC : D.C.BlockTriangular id) (i j : ι) :
    columnTail D.C i j ⬝ᵥ D.Cinv.mulVec (Pi.single i 1) =
      D.C i j

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CartanCoordinate.WeaklyPositiveCartanData.inverse_diagonal_eq_one

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CartanCoordinate.WeaklyPositiveCartanData.inverse_mulVec_columnTail
statement:
theorem inverse_mulVec_columnTail
    (D : WeaklyPositiveCartanData (ι := ι))
    (hC : D.C.BlockTriangular id)
    {i j t : ι} (hit : i ≤ t) :
    D.Cinv.mulVec (columnTail D.C i j) t =
      (Pi.single j (1 : ℤ) : ι → ℤ) t

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CartanCoordinate.WeaklyPositiveCartanData.quadraticForm_columnTail

    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    quadraticForm D.Cinv (columnTail D.C i j) = 1
